left.raw_text: Any concomitant cardiovascular procedure to CABG (i.e. valve, aortic or carotid surgery)
NSTE-ACS with cardiogenic shock warranting emergent salvage surgery within 12 hrs from hospital admission
Current renal (creatinine>2x upper limit of normal (ULN), dialysis, kidney transplant)
or hepatic dysfunction (AST/ALT>2x ULN, liver transplant or neoplasm)
